scientific_scope_status: The delivered completed conditional force compiler replaces separate remembered recognition bits with a joint commitment coordinate. Full-stroke good/bad/all-force bands satisfying2g>fmax+b permit the current-contact barrier; a preloaded ordinary linear spring reproduces it. A finite-inertia extension additionally requires a strict incoming-energy ceiling and fixed ownership/pose.
